_comment: One entry per book. 'entry' is the docs/ page (without .md) the book opens on; 'stem' is the file stem used by the docs/Makefile for PDF/EPUB artifacts (edumatcher_<stem>_a4-<version>.pdf). Add a book here and the Learn, Documentation and Download pages pick it up on the next build.

books.title: Quick Start Guide
books.blurb: Install, first trade, a full trading day and your own configuration — a checkpoint at every step.

books.title: Training Guide
books.blurb: 29 hands-on chapters: order types, auctions, market making, risk, clearing, protocols.

books.title: Participant Guide
books.blurb: The order book, every order type, auctions, market making, bots, P&L and the trading screens.

books.title: Operator's Guide
books.blurb: Install, configure, run, supervise and recover an exchange — gateways, risk, audit, persistence.

books.title: Protocols and Clients
books.blurb: ALF, BALF, CALF, RALF, LALF and REST/WebSocket — specifications, sessions and client examples.

books.title: Reference Manual
books.blurb: Every command, port, configuration field and a finance glossary.

books.title: Architecture & Developer Guide
books.blurb: The design, the data structures, the code tour and how to change it with confidence.

books.title: AI Traders & Market Simulation
books.blurb: An exchange that trades itself: AI traders, hidden true values, news and rumours.

primer.title: How an Exchange Works
primer.blurb: Order books, bids and asks, auctions and market makers — no finance background required.
